formal_name: Adaptive Asymptotic Trust Ceiling with Borderline Authorization Debt (AATC-BAD)

E_t.description: Exponentially weighted moving average of anomaly magnitude (preserved from B0)

D_t.description: Borderline Authorization Debt (tracks cumulative high-trust borderline consumption)

C_t.description: Adaptive Asymptotic Trust Ceiling (upper bound for trust recovery)

update_equations.step_1_debt_increment: Delta_D_t = (A_t - q_low) / (A_thr - q_low) if (T_t >= T_allow and q_low <= A_t < A_thr) else 0.0
update_equations.step_2_debt_update: D_{t+1} = max(0.0, D_t - delta_D) if (A_t < q_low) else (D_t + Delta_D_t)
update_equations.step_3_ceiling_update: C_{t+1} = max(C_floor, 1.0 - eta_C * max(0.0, D_{t+1} - K_allow))

step_4_b0_energy_and_sb.SB_next: SB_{t+1} = SB_t + lambda if E_{t+1} > gamma else max(0.0, SB_t - delta)

update_equations.step_6_policy_gate: Policy_{t+1} = ALLOW if T_{t+1} >= T_allow else (VERIFY if T_{t+1} >= T_quar else BLOCK)

trigger_conditions.debt_accrual_trigger: Active ONLY on conjunction: (T_t >= T_allow) AND (A_t in [q_low, A_thr)). Does NOT accrue during VERIFY or BLOCK, and does NOT accrue on overt anomalies.
trigger_conditions.ceiling_drop_trigger: C_t drops below 1.0 ONLY when D_t > K_allow.
trigger_conditions.allow_demotion_trigger: Device is structurally demoted from ALLOW to VERIFY when C_t < T_allow (0.80).

recovery_behavior.debt_relaxation: D decays linearly at rate delta_D = 0.10 for each packet with A_t < q_low.
recovery_behavior.ceiling_rehabilitation: As D decays back below K_allow, C_t recovers linearly to 1.0.
recovery_behavior.trust_rehabilitation: Once C_t >= T_allow, trust recovery can again reach ALLOW.
